dataset.dataset_version_record: Zenodo 6576203, Version 2.0 HDF5 record; sample mirrored in SOFA database
dataset.room_corner_units_note: RoomCornerA/B do not carry a Units attribute in the inspected file; their values are interpreted in the SOFA room coordinate metre scale and are consistent with the paper's approximately 6 x 6 x 2.4 m room. Room dimensions are metadata only and are not used by extraction.
dataset.synchronization_evidence: dEchorate paper states synchronous multichannel acquisition at 48 kHz; SOFA Data.Delay is zero for all five stored channels; not independently remeasured here.
dataset.calibration_provenance: SOFA coordinates and room corners; paper reports bIPS position acquisition with +/-2 cm error; this is not independent BatSight survey.

dataset.annotation_method: dEchorate GUI annotations: manually tuned peak finder and echo/wall labels; paper provides no per-label numeric uncertainty.

ground_truth.method: dEchorate GUI annotations: manually tuned peak finder and echo/wall labels; paper provides no per-label numeric uncertainty.
ground_truth.provider_timing_uncertainty: not numerically specified in the paper or annotation file

calibration_audit.channel_order: SOFA ReceiverPosition order; five named channels mic1..mic5
calibration_audit.sound_speed: 346.98 m/s from dEchorate paper environmental condition; not measured on this sample by BatSight
calibration_audit.recording_time_origin: SOFA Data.Delay is zero for all channels; RIR sample zero treated as common time origin; no raw loopback channel retained in this SOFA file
calibration_audit.event_reference: RIR excitation is represented as a zero-origin impulse response; no raw sweep/loopback waveform is present

extraction.input_kind: measured deconvolved RIR, not original raw ESS recording
extraction.reference: single-sample unit impulse; matched-filter correlation therefore equals the RIR
extraction.matching_tolerance_source: 0.5 ms threshold used by dEchorate paper's goodness-of-match metric; adopted here for external annotation comparison, not inferred annotation uncertainty

summary.accuracy_claim: single SOFA RIR configuration/source/array subset only; not raw-sweep validation or broad reliability estimate

limitations: Only one source and one five-microphone array subset was evaluated.
SOFA contains deconvolved measured RIRs rather than the raw ESS input; the impulse reference bypasses probe matching and ESS deconvolution.
Provider annotations are manually generated and paper gives no per-label numeric uncertainty; a 0.5 ms comparison threshold does not turn them into independent instrument timing.
Synchronization is supported by acquisition documentation and zero SOFA delays but was not independently verified from raw loopback or hardware clocks.
Echo candidates are compared only against the six provider first-order annotations in this selected event. No wall label is exposed to extraction.
No parameter tuning was performed; the existing Phase 5E.1 defaults were retained.
